metadata.description: Configuration for the handoff readiness status engine (Phase 9D). Readiness is a procedural check — not a quality score, not a clinical recommendation. Edit checks or weights here without a code change; bump schema_version and document why.
metadata.warning: Do not add clinical-judgment or quality-scoring logic to this file. The readiness status is purely procedural.

do_not_hand_off.label: Do not hand off without calling

disclaimer: Readiness is a procedural check — it confirms the packet contains expected structural elements (backup option, intake label, verification freshness, crisis fallback). It is not a clinical recommendation, not a quality score, and not a substitute for confirming details directly with each program. ViableMHR is not emergency care; call 988 for crisis support or 911 for immediate danger.

checks.label: At least one program selected
checks.description: Packet must have at least one program before any status is computed.
checks.failure_message: No programs selected. Add at least one program to the handoff.

checks.label: Backup option exists
checks.description: At least 2 programs selected, giving the family a fallback if the first call does not work.
checks.failure_message: No backup option. Add a second program in case the first is unavailable, has a waitlist, or does not accept the insurance.

checks.label: Backup differs on at least one dimension
checks.description: Primary and backup options should differ on insurance type listed, city, or virtual/in-person — otherwise the backup provides little practical redundancy.
checks.failure_message: Primary and backup options are similar on all key dimensions. Consider adding a program that differs on insurance, city, or virtual availability.

checks.label: Care level matches scenario
checks.description: Every selected program lists the requested care level, or an adjacent level the planner accepted.
checks.failure_message: One or more programs do not list the requested care level. Confirm care level directly with the program.

checks.label: Age band fits all selected programs
checks.description: Every selected program serves the scenario's age band.
checks.failure_message: One or more programs may not serve the age band in this scenario. Confirm age eligibility.

checks.label: Insurance status clear or explicitly tagged call-to-verify
checks.description: No selected program shows insurance_unclear flag without a confirm prompt.
checks.failure_message: Insurance status is unclear for one or more programs. Confirm accepted plans before handing off.

checks.label: Intake/admissions phone labeled
checks.description: Every selected program has a labeled intake phone so the planner knows what number to give the family.
checks.failure_message: Intake phone is not labeled for one or more programs. Confirm whether the listed number is intake, main reception, or crisis before handing off.
checks.data_gap_note: As of 2026-Q2, 112/112 records lack a labeled intake phone. This check will show needs_confirmation across most packets until backfill is complete.

checks.label: Verification within 90 days
checks.description: Every selected program was verified within the last 90 days.
checks.failure_message: One or more programs have not been verified within 90 days. Confirm details are current.

checks.label: Crisis fallback included
checks.description: The packet always includes 988/911 language. This is asserted, not user-toggled.
checks.failure_message: Crisis fallback block is missing. This should not happen — contact support.

checks.label: No stale data combined with missing intake label
checks.description: A program that is both verification-stale and has no intake label creates a compounding risk.
checks.failure_message: One or more programs are both verification-stale and missing an intake phone label. Do not hand off without a direct call to each affected program.

checks.label: Location or virtual fit considered
checks.description: Every program is either in the scenario's geography or is virtual when the scenario allows virtual.
checks.failure_message: One or more programs may not serve the selected geography. Confirm whether the program accepts the family's location or offers virtual services.

status_assignment_rules.description: Check failures escalate status by severity. The highest-severity failing check wins. Multiple failures of the same severity do not compound beyond that level.
status_assignment_rules.note: blocking checks prevent any further evaluation and immediately return do_not_hand_off

print_behavior.note: Print is never blocked by readiness status. The status is informational. The planner is always the decision-maker.
